column1: # Board id -> programming-port USB identity, tab-separated.
# This identifies the UART/USB-Serial-JTAG bridge used to flash each board,
# not the board's own USB-OTG image stream (that identity comes from
# CONFIG_TINYUSB_DESC_PRODUCT_STRING in the board's sdkconfig.defaults and
# only exists once our firmware is already running). The bridge's vendor:
# product id and product string are fixed by that chip, unrelated to our
# firmware config. tools/flash.py uses these identities to select the matching
# board when multiple programming ports are connected. Verify a board's actual
# or .../ttyACM*/device idVendor, idProduct, product) before adding a row.
